Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the time on the discovery call last week — good discussion and clear signal that DatumAI is targeting a late-Q3 move off the current self-hosted inference stack. To make the PoC productive we recommend a 75–90 minute technical deep-dive focused on: model packaging/format differences, KV cache migration, network egress patterns, and a short ops runbook review (deploy, monitoring, fallback).

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Wed Aug 4: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Thu Aug 5: 09:00–10:30 or 16:00–17:30

Attendees we plan to bring: Karthik (serving lead), Marissa (solutions/ops), and myself. Please confirm the right technical contacts from your side (engineering + infra) and any additional constraints (e.g., strict blackout windows). I attached a short pre-read and a draft agenda to help folks prepare.

If those windows don't work, suggest two alternatives and we'll adapt.

Thanks — Vivek

Perfect — 10:30–12:00 PDT on Wed Aug 4 confirmed. Sending calendar invite now (datumai-invite.ics attached).

Quick answers:
- Primary models are Hugging Face format (custom tokenizer wrapper) and one legacy ONNX path for small models. Typical sequence lengths: 16–128 tokens, with occasional 512 for analytics jobs.
- We do need IP allowlisting for our test instances; I'll share the CIDR blocks and a short network diagram before the call.

See you all then.
